items.summary: Recommendation: retain the implementation and financial-claim gates, approve only the bounded Save Us Farms public-surface inspection, and reject any revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, forecast, budget-exposure, or causal-lift claim this cycle. Amazon data for 2026-09-21 reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but the commission is entirely on aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0 and no site revenue claim is supported. AI usage for 2026-10-01 is $34.69846565 across 223 calls and 20 observed sites versus 38 expected, with 3 errors. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue and AI spend are not period-aligned, AI allocation is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent, and outcome deltas cannot be causally matched to one-day spend. Minimum measurement is period-aligned revenue by registered tracking ID, AI cost by site/work item, infrastructure and domain cost records, and dated treatment/control exposures with attributable conversions. Do not request duplicate telemetry; retain the existing gates and require registered tracking IDs for future affiliate links.
